name: super-log
description: super-log SDK: log to a super-log hub over one small wire protocol. The default install is the zero-dependency C header; the [cpp] feature adds the header-only C++ SDK (event model, SN_LOG). The spdlog sink header is included; add spdlog yourself (or the [spdlog] feature) to compile it.

cpp.description: The header-only C++ SDK: the event model and SN_LOG. Depends on ts-moveables.

spdlog.description: Pull spdlog so the included spdlog sink header (super_log/spdlog_sink.hpp) compiles out of the box.
